Definition: Abinadab, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Abinadab is the name of four Israelites. The ark lodges at the house of Abinadab in Kirjath-jearim for twenty years; Jesse’s second son Abinadab is passed over when Samuel anoints David; and Uzzah the son of Abinadab dies touching the ark.
TheologicalSignificance: Four men share the name, and the ark runs through three of them — housed, passed over, and mishandled. I believe Abinadab’s name is tied to the ark because God keeps His presence near ordinary households, and how we treat holy things matters more than how long we have lived beside them.
